name: Phone P-008 isolated worker negative controls
command: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/call-recovery.ts --mutate 's/count\.fallback >= 1/count.fallback >= 99/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.test.ts' --expect caught

PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/call-recovery.ts --mutate 's/bargeIn\(\) \{ this\.speaking\(\); \}/bargeIn() { }/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.test.ts' --expect caught

PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/call-recovery.ts --mutate 's/this\.limits\.inputMs\);/this.limits.inputMs * 100);/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.test.ts' --expect caught

PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/call-recovery.ts --mutate 's/Math\.abs\(s\) > 100/Math.abs(s) > 32767/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.test.ts' --expect caught

PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/call-recovery.ts --mutate 's/this\.limits\.responseMs\);/this.limits.responseMs * 100);/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.test.ts' --expect caught

PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace $PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT/scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file worker/src/agent.ts --mutate 's/if \(matchesAuthority\(current\) && !authorityRevoked/if (true && !authorityRevoked/' --test 'PROBE_SUBJECT={} npm --prefix worker test -- src/call-recovery.integration.test.ts' --expect caught
summary: Six copy-out overlay mutation probes in the registered phone-app staging repo each passed the baseline, changed one worker behavior, triggered a specific Vitest assertion failure, returned verdict=caught, and verified source byte integrity. These establish software guard falsifiability only; no carrier or public PSTN was exercised.

assertions.evidence: Allowing 99 fallback reservations instead of one failed call-recovery.test.ts:28: denied.reject was not called; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.
Removing bargeIn cancellation failed call-recovery.test.ts:86: no_response_audio fired after interruption; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.

Multiplying input deadline by 100 failed call-recovery.test.ts:100: no_input_audio was not emitted by the expected deadline; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.

Raising the non-silent PCM threshold above Int16 range failed call-recovery.test.ts:104: real recovery WAV was rejected as silent; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.

Multiplying response deadline by 100 failed call-recovery.test.ts:89: stalled response did not trigger no_response_audio by the bound; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.

Bypassing sidecar authority match failed call-recovery.integration.test.ts:61: provider-free fallback was called after revocation; baseline 7/7 passed, mutant 1 failed/6 passed, verdict=caught, tree integrity verified.

executionNote: Run these commands from the registered phone-app root after setting PAPERCUSP_REPO_ROOT to the canonical Papercusp checkout. The original invocations used that checkout's absolute script path; the variable removes a machine-specific path from the recorded commands.
